for more details - refer to Control statement
Must-Have Metrics
1. Resource Utilization:
- CPU usage, Memory utilization, Storage capacity and I/O performance, Network throughput and latency
2. Application Performance:
- Response times, Error rates, Transaction volumes, API call latency
3. Security and Compliance:
- Failed login attempts, Unusual access patterns, Configuration changes, Compliance status
4. Cost Optimization:
- Resource costs by service, Idle resources, Underutilized instances
Monitoring Frequency
1. Real-time monitoring for critical metrics (e.g., application availability, security events)
2. 5-minute intervals for resource utilization metrics
3. Hourly aggregation for performance trends
4. Daily cost analysis and optimization reports
Centralized Monitoring Platform
Implement a unified monitoring solution that can integrate data from all cloud providers
Auto-Discovery and Scaling
Set up automatic discovery of new resources to ensure comprehensive coverage as the infrastructure scales
Standardized KPIs
Define standardized KPIs across all cloud platforms to enable consistent comparison and analysis
Alerting and Notification
Configure real-time alerts for critical issues, with escalation procedures for unresolved problems.
Dashboard and Visualization
Create customized dashboards for different teams (e.g., DevOps, Security, Management) to provide relevant insights
Automated Response
Implement automated responses for common issues, such as auto-scaling during traffic spikes or initiating failover procedures
